assumptions.assignment_basis: Shortest generalised cost among paths with zero to two inter-line changes, including street access and egress. Equal costs prefer fewer changes.
assumptions.scope: Rail trips with walking access. Relative demand and segment shares require local trip data and timetable evidence to establish passenger counts and capacity.
assumptions.service_basis: Simulated bidirectional all-stops rail with continuous headways. Running train-km exclude depot and turnback movements.

street_source.scope: Step-excluded walking estimate; ordinary roads without sidewalks can remain. No wheelchair-passability or safe-crossing certificate.

assumptions.waiting_basis: Each boarding waits half its directional headway. Transfer walk counts as elapsed time and the transfer penalty contributes to generalised cost.
assumptions.walking_eligibility_basis: Each endpoint has a feasible directed street walk to or from at least one station within the walking and snap limits.
assumptions.weight_basis: Origin population share multiplied by the assigned centre destination share. All networks use these same ordered pairs and weights.
assumptions.witness_basis: For each observed transfer count, use the assigned path for the highest-weight pair.

assumptions.assignment_basis: Continuous bidirectional all-stop service with half a headway at each boarding. Transfer counts describe the path of least generalised cost without a transfer cap.
assumptions.demand_basis: Population-weighted tiles and exponential distance decay create synthetic OD weights.
assumptions.paired_basis: Elapsed P90 uses identical OD pairs served in both compared plans. Served shares and transfer distribution use all OD weights in the displayed cohort.
assumptions.service_basis: Equal scheduled running train-km exclude depot moves, terminal work and spare fleet.

street_source.scope: Step-excluded walking estimate; ordinary roads without sidewalks can remain. No wheelchair-passability or safe-crossing certificate.

cohort_definitions.centre–outer: One endpoint inside the central box and one outside.
cohort_definitions.inner-city: Both endpoints inside the retained central box.
cohort_definitions.inter-district: Both endpoints outside the central box in different metric district grid cells.
cohort_definitions.outer-local: Both endpoints outside the central box in the same metric district grid cell.
cohort_definitions.wide-angle inter-district: Subset of inter-district pairs with at least 45 degrees of bearing separation around the midpoint of the central box.

search.connectivity_alternative_ranking_basis: 22–23 km with at least three direct spokes and seven screened interchanges, then most direct spokes, most interchanges and the area-led rank
search.connectivity_basis: At least three dry interchanges, two direct M09 spokes and one interchange on each bank
search.ranking_basis: 22–23 km band, at least 20 km, fewer >100° turns after 25 m simplification, then area and distance to target
